text:
Iris: Postmortem up for the evening tail-latency spikes. Recurring pattern Tue/Thu 17:00-19:00. Need concrete follow-ups on SLOs + dashboards.
Ben: reading. quick numbers?
Iris: p95 ~200ms stable, p99 baseline 420ms but spikes to ~1.5s during surges. Error-budget burn correlates with queue depth and bursty requests.
Sanya: prefer not to change customer-facing p99 unless we have no other options. proposal: add a transient burst SLI (p999 over 5m) + operational guards and routing fallbacks.
Lucas: agree. we can also add a "burst tolerance" SLI so we capture tail behaviour without altering SLA. Dashboard changes first.
Ben: ops-bot showed burn windows: Tue 16:45-18:20, Thu 17:10-18:15. Link to SLO: https://console.redwood/slo/incident-4420
ops-bot: ALERT: error_budget_burn rate=0.36 over 24h; recent alerts: 4 in last 7d.
Iris: action items (owner -> due): 1) Add burst SLI (p999 5m) + dashboard panels (owner: Lucas -> due: 2026-04-26). 2) Implement routing guard to quantized fallback when queue_ms > 300 AND inflight_per_gpu > 28 (owner: Ben -> due: 2026-04-23). 3) Canary plan for batching/kv-cache thresholds, synthetic peak test 48h (owner: Sanya -> due: 2026-05-07). 4) Postmortem follow-up doc w/ acceptance and rollback criteria (owner: Iris -> due: 2026-04-29).
Ben: small note on #2: add a throttle at p95 queue threshold to avoid global fallback. Will include config snippet in PR.
Ben: ```yaml
serving:
  fallback_policy: quantized-variant
  guards:
    queue_ms_threshold: 300
    max_inflight_per_gpu: 28
    deprioritize_tags: ["batch", "non-critical"]
  throttles:
    p95_queue_ms: 120
    max_inflight_per_gpu_override: 24
```
Lucas: dashboard panels requested: p95, p99, p999-burst(5m), error-budget burn by weekday/hour, queue depth heatmap, incident annotations. I'll also tag the postmortem link on the panels. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/serving/slo
Sanya: canary plan: synthetic client at 3x peak for 48h, collect kv-cache hit rates, per-model queue depth, and token-level latencies. Will post exact test steps to the follow-up doc.
Iris: alerting addition: page eng-oncall when p99 > 800ms for 30m AND burn_rate > 20% in 24h. Otherwise send warning to #serving-slo.
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window 2026-04-25 02:00-03:00 UTC (informational).
Ben: I'll open serving-config PR for guards/throttles and tag @ops. PR will include unit tests for rule matcher.
Lucas: dashboard PR by EOD Wednesday, will also add a short explainer for the burst SLI.
Sanya: requested canary infra reservations. will link test harness.
Iris: we will not change customer SLA now. Deploy guards + dashboards, monitor for 2 weeks, then revisit SLO roll criteria. I'll create an action tracker card and ping owners daily until closed.
Ben: starting PR today.
Lucas: annotating incidents on the dash now.
Sanya: doc skeleton up by Fri.
Iris: thanks team. i'll mention this in next oncall handoff and the all-hands SRE update. :thumbsup:
